verdict.rationale: Foreloop has a global CLI with stable `--json` output that can be called from cron or scripts, but that only automates Foreloop's own objects (projects, intentions, tasks). It is not a way to run an agent headlessly. The docs describe the agent (Claude Code or Codex) running in a checkout on your own machine and polling Foreloop for tasks, with no documented headless or CI/CD agent execution mode. Scriptability of the CLI and the third-party agents' own runtimes are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts
